paragraphs: The X-Type 2.0 V6 uses the AJ20 engine — a 2.0-litre V6 petrol unit derived from the Ford Duratec family. It was fitted from 2001 to 2009 across the X400 generation. A smaller displacement sibling to the 2.5 V6 (AJ25) and 3.0 V6 (AJ30), the 2.0-litre offers a smooth petrol alternative in a range otherwise dominated by diesel options. The X-Type is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every X-Type 2.0 V6 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre V6 petrol engine fitted to the X-Type from 2001 to 2009 (X400). Known for ignition coil degradation over time — see the callout above. We replace ignition coils and valve cover gaskets as standard on every AJ20 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Your X-Type 2.0 V6 uses the AJ20 engine, a member of the Ford Duratec-derived AJ-family of V6 engines. While the 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0-litre versions share a similar architecture, component compatibility (especially for ignition coils and gaskets) can differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ20, AJ25 or AJ30) via registration or VIN

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X-Type 2.0 V6 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
